question: Which one of the following books is NOT authored by Amartya Sen?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Poverty of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poverty and Un-British Rule in India**

 
 
• **Author**: The book was written by **Dadabhai Naoroji**, who was also known as the **"Grand Old Man of India"**.
 
• **Year of Publication**: The book was **published in 1901**.
 
• **Focus**: It **criticized the economic impact of British rule** on India, particularly how British policies drained India's wealth and resources.
 
• **Concept**: The book presented the **drain theory**, explaining how the British exploited India's wealth over their **200-year rule**.
 
• **Role of Dadabhai Naoroji**: He was not only a Parsi scholar but also the **official ambassador of India** and a member of the **Liberal Party of the British Parliament**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amartya Sen**

 
 
• **Profession**: He is an **Indian philosopher and economist** known for his extensive work in welfare economics and social justice.
 
• **Academic Career**: Amartya Sen has been teaching at **Harvard University** since **1987**.
 
• **Nobel Prize**: In **1998**, he was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Economics** for his contributions to **welfare economics**, particularly in understanding famines and economic disparities.
 
• **Recommended Author**: He is frequently recommended for reading on platforms like **Five Books**.
